mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_trending (post_id, score, view_count, like_count, comment_count, date, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{trending.postId}, #{trending.score}, #{trending.viewCount}, #{trending.likeCount}, #{trending.commentCount}, #{trending.statDate}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = #{trending.score}, view_count = #{trending.viewCount}, like_count = #{trending.likeCount}, comment_count = #{trending.commentCount}, update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_trending WHERE date = ( SELECT MAX(date) FROM blog_trending t2 WHERE t2.post_id = blog_trending.post_id )
